title: Sheinbaum and Jalisco governor announce Guadalajara water aqueducts
detail: At her Oct 28 conference, with Jalisco governor Pablo Lemus present, Sheinbaum discussed water supply and quality for the Guadalajara metro area. UnoTV reported two planned aqueducts (Chapala-Guadalajara and Calderón-San Gaspar) and a follow-up commission; investment figures differed between outlets.
